The '''BLC-2 burst laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. BLC-2 burst cannons were considered to be the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] equivalent of a [[Scattergun/Legends|scattergun]], as it fired a cluster of high-damage bolts in a wide arc with a slow rate of fire. The BLC-2s were used primarily at close range, as they conserved large amounts of power and were ineffective at greater distances.
